title: Once lit, does a gas flame go out by itself?

baseline.what: always predict the most common outcome

rules.message: Lunar-like air (O2 >= 30%, <= 70.3 kPa): only 20 real tests here, so no model value. See the nearest tests.

caveats: 'Kept burning' means it burned until the fuel flow was cut.
sources: PSI-159 CFI-G Final Report (FinalRpt_ACME.CFI-G.pdf), Tables 1-2 p. 21-22
